summary: Tested new backend (contact + guestbook) and frontend features (contact form, native guestbook, audio queue/waveform, Reproducir todo, corneta/legion queue buttons, Spain flag emblem). Backend: 7/7 pytest features passing. Frontend: all data-testid flows verified end-to-end via public URL, including 1 real contact email + real guestbook signature. Mobile 375px sanity for /libro-de-visitas and player bar confirmed (next button correctly hidden on mobile).
critical_code_review_comments: In-memory rate limiter dicts (_RATE) in routes/contact.py and routes/guestbook.py never prune keys; over long uptime the dict grows unbounded (minor memory leak). Consider periodic cleanup or capping by size.
Guestbook honeypot triggers 400 while contact honeypot silently returns 200. Behavior is intentional per problem statement but inconsistent — worth documenting.
No index on guestbook.created_at in MongoDB — list_entries uses .sort('created_at', -1) which will do a collection scan when the collection grows. Add an index at startup.
server.py still has legacy /api/status routes and StatusCheck models unrelated to the site — dead code, safe to remove.
CORS is wide open (allow_origins=* by default). For a real deployment restrict to the site domain.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 guestbook entries via tests (TEST_* prefixed + TESTUI* UI test). Sent 1 real contact email (subject: 'Test agente UI — favor de ignorar').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend was restarted at test start to reset in-memory rate limiters (contact 5/h, guestbook 3/h per IP). If retesting soon, expect 429s — restart backend to reset. Real emails go to CONTACT_TO_EMAIL — do NOT loop contact submissions. test_features.py uses BASE=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL public URL; test_api.py uses localhost.
